stories.headline: D.H. Identified; Pemwick Sits Down Slowly; the Jeep Receives a Fourth Duck and Does Not Seem Surprised
stories.byline: By our Travelling Correspondent, filing from the Appalachian Circuit
body: The Duck Provenance Office closed its Priority Amber inquiry at 9:47 this morning after junior analyst Pemwick, working through the weekend on a single lead from Mabel Forsythe-Crue's index card, matched the initials D.H. to one Delphine Holt — circuit walker, trail-keeper, and semi-legendary figure of the Appalachian hollows, whose last confirmed sighting was in 1999 and whose last confirmed good deed was approximately this morning.

Holt, 71, has walked the Appalachian circuit for four decades. She is not a prankster, not a vandal, and emphatically not, as one early theory suggested, 'a charm-happy eccentric with a surplus of felt.' She is, according to three separate ridge communities who asked not to be named but were clearly pleased to be asked, someone who notices. She notices who keeps their trails clean and their machines in good order. She notices who comes back to the same gorges with the same care and takes nothing but mud on the tyres. She has been noticing Christine and Steve for some time.

The hatted ducks, Pemwick's final report concludes, are not a prank. They are a classification — Holt's own private registry, carried in a saddlebag, left without ceremony on the vehicles of people she considers worth the blessing. A fourth duck appeared on the Jeep this morning: flat wool cap, six-point crown, set at the same jaunty angle as its companions. There is no note. There is no need for one. The Jeep, for its part, has arranged all four ducks along the dashboard with what Steve describes as 'an air of quiet pride.' He has not moved them. He does not intend to.

stories.headline: Quoyne Reads Pemwick's Final Report; Describes It as 'Thorough'; This Is the Highest Praise He Gives
body: Senior Registrar Quoyne received a courtesy copy of the Duck Provenance Office's closed file this afternoon, read it in full without comment, set it squarely on the left corner of his desk, and described it, when pressed, as 'thorough.' His deputy has confirmed that 'thorough' is the highest compliment in Quoyne's vocabulary, above 'correct,' 'properly filed,' and 'plumb.'

Quoyne has made no further statement, but observers note that the 'Wholesome, Not Misc.' registry — currently holding two entries — was briefly taken down from its shelf, examined, and replaced at a marginally more prominent position. The shelf remains level. Quoyne confirmed this himself before leaving for the evening.

stories.headline: Monday's First Account Resolved Before the Second Was Opened; Goblin Clerk Describes the Interval as 'Geometrically Efficient'
body: Christine arrived at Gringotts on Monday morning to find two accounts in dispute, one goblin already mid-complaint, and a junior clerk attempting to locate a file that had been misfiled under 'G' for 'Grievance' rather than 'A' for 'Account, Obviously.' She resolved the first dispute during the file search, addressed the junior clerk's misfiling system with three sentences that will be posted on the wall near the cabinets, and opened the second account before the relevant goblin had finished his opening remarks.

The morning's work was logged at 11:04. The Goblin Senior Council, which tracks these intervals, has noted the result in a column they have titled, with characteristic restraint, 'Reference Times.' Christine's entry is at the top. It has been there since March.

stories.headline: Lucy Studies the Biscuit Tin's New Position With Academic Intensity; Has Not Moved; Has Not Looked Away
body: The biscuit tin, now in its fifth consecutive fixed position, has attracted renewed attention from the household's senior familiar, who has adopted a seated posture approximately three feet from the counter and has maintained it, without apparent fatigue, for the better part of the afternoon. No attempt has been made. No approach has been initiated. Analysts describe this as 'the research phase,' and note that the research phase has historically preceded several of the household's more significant incidents.

Ellie spent the morning in the garden and returned with convictions about a particular patch of grass that she has been unable to adequately communicate to the others. Jersey was on the sofa. He remains on the sofa. He is warm and untroubled. He sends his regards.

familiars_corner: Lucy: Has completed seventeen minutes of uninterrupted observation of the biscuit tin and considers the data collection phase nearly sufficient. She has not announced this. She does not announce things.

Ellie: Came inside with great urgency, looked around the kitchen as though expecting to find something she had sent ahead of herself, and, finding nothing, sat down contentedly and accepted a scratch behind the ear as full resolution of the matter.

Jersey: The fourth duck's arrival has not altered Jersey's opinion that the sofa remains the most strategically important location in the household, and he intends to defend it by being extremely comfortable on it for the foreseeable future.
founding_editor_note: Forty years I walked these mountains and I never once left a hat on anything — but I respect the craftsmanship. Six-point crown is the right way to do it. — D.

in_brief.sport: The Gringotts Vaulting League has requested that Monday's resolution interval be submitted as an official record; the governing body is consulting the rulebook to determine whether 'before the opposing goblin finished his sentence' constitutes a legal category.
in_brief.forecast: Fair and settled across the hollows; the ridgeline reports that autumn is conducting itself with full commitment and does not require further commentary on the matter.

storyline_updates.title: The Duck Bandit Returns
storyline_updates.summary: Resolved Monday. D.H. identified as Delphine Holt, 71, Appalachian circuit walker and trail-keeper, who leaves hatted ducks on the vehicles of people she considers worth a blessing. She has been noticing Christine and Steve for some time. A fourth duck arrived Monday morning — flat wool cap, six-point crown. All four are now on the Jeep's dashboard. Pemwick's final report filed and commended by Quoyne as 'thorough.' The Bandit is not a mystery anymore; she is an acknowledgement. The ducks stay.
